notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[0].options.Array.data[0].playerLine
source_en: Any advice for my first day?

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[0].options.Array.data[0].npcResponse
source_en: Yeah. Trust nobody, believe nothing they tell you, and don't puke on the paperwork. That's the whole job.

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[0].options.Array.data[1].playerLine

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[0].options.Array.data[1].npcResponse
source_en: Kid, I've seen inspectors quit by lunch. You've got that new-boots shine on you. Ask me again in a week.

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[0].options.Array.data[2].playerLine

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[0].options.Array.data[2].npcResponse
source_en: Above your pay grade. Just check the papers, stamp the form, and keep the line moving. Questions get you nowhere fast.

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[1].greetingLine
source_en: Huh. Didn't think you'd show up again.

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[1].options.Array.data[0].playerLine

notes: SuspectWorldDialogue on Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant (Suspect_Soldier_At post Variant) > daySets.Array.data[1].options.Array.data[0].npcResponse
source_en: Tip? Don't trust the calm ones. The nervous ones are usually just nervous. It's the ones smiling too much you gotta watch.
